prompt: Use case: identity-preserve story scene edit. Image1 canonical character portrait is identity authority; image2 Engineering ROOM GEOMETRY ONLY, do not copy its graphs; image3 is the current scene to replace. Keep the exact canonical face, age, facial structure, complexion, hair and uniform. Natural moderately stylized adult head size, short relaxed neck, ordinary shoulders. Two coherent arms, natural wrist alignment and five fingers per hand with plausible contact. Candid three-quarter work scene, never looking at camera. Text, borders, grids and arrows follow their physical screen's perspective. Muted sage #6BAA8A, aged brass #A89060, charcoal, natural skin, restrained warm practical light. No neon green, random diagrams, fake text, invented results, camera-facing paper, extra people or body-furniture intersections. All unused screens and wrist displays inactive charcoal. Landscape1536x1024. Completely restage Chief Nazari at her Engineering workbench, no front-facing pose. Medium three-quarter side view: she sits on left of image looking right at her angled working monitor. Her expression is focused with a small skeptical raised eyebrow as she verifies the procedure. One hand naturally operates a trackball on clear desk surface; the other rests on a closed maintenance notebook. Preserve the old stopwatch as a small face-down instrument beside the notebook, no readable timing result. Both arms supported and separate, no crossing through desk. Working monitor faces her, camera beside her sees the same front. Exact screen: title 'Gradient workflow'. Three vertically connected rows with modest downward arrows: 'Forward: compute loss' then 'Backward: compute gradients' then 'Optimizer: update weights'. Below: 'Reuse the forward computation'. Small separate footer 'Measure on the target device'. This is a procedural review, no benchmark result or sample loss. Main monitor the only lit information surface; rear screens off. Maintain her mature canonical face and grey-streaked hair, balanced body proportions. Her attention and raised eyebrow tell a practical verification story.
